title: 第11章举报王师兄被罚面壁思过第12章宗门强制任务
slug: 凡人修仙疯了吧你一百岁了还要修仙

翌日，北寒风把装着‘回春丹’的木盒往怀一塞，深吸了一口气，就向着白芷洞府所在的向走去。
内门弟子区域守卫森严，不过好在他也挂着一个内门弟子名头，在经过一些拦询后，还是进入了内门弟子区域。
不过当他经过指引到达白芷洞府，发现白芷没在。
他只能在洞门外耐心等待，这一等就是大半天。
终于，一道熟悉的白色剑光从天而降，落在附近。
正是返回洞府的白芷。
“白仙子！”
北寒风连忙上前，恭敬行礼。
白芷看到北寒风，清冷的眸中闪过一丝讶异：“北寒风？……你不在废丹院，在此何事？”
北寒风脸上露出惶恐又恳切的神色道：“白仙子，老朽有事相求，事关老朽的生命安全。”
白芷秀眉微蹙，打量了他一番，见他神情不似作伪，略一沉吟，道：“随我来。”
她没有带北寒风进入洞府，而是带到附近一处僻静的凉亭。
“说吧，何事？”
北寒风不再犹豫，小心取出装有回春丹木盒，轻轻打开，双手递给白芷
“此中品回春丹是老朽用攒下来的下品练气丹换的，承蒙仙子照顾，才得以进入仙门，因此想用这两颗回春丹作为感谢仙子之礼！”
白芷目光扫过木盒中那两颗莹润丹药，确实是中品回春丹。不过她并未接过，只是淡淡道：“你有何事，直言便是。不必如此。”
北寒风收回木盒，脸上皱纹更深，声音带着几分苦涩：“不敢欺瞒仙子。前些时日，有位叫王同源的外门师兄带人前来废丹院，强索赤阳草残渣，并对老朽多有……折辱。老朽年迈体衰，修为低微，实不堪其扰。故而冒昧前来，恳请仙子……能否代为转圜，或给予些许庇护？”
白芷闻言，眉头微蹙。
她对那位外门的王同源倒是略有耳闻，仗着是外门一位执事的族亲，平日在外门嚣张跋扈，外门弟子和杂役弟子没少被他欺辱。

她看向北寒风，这老叟气息微弱，站在此地都显得颤巍巍，确实可怜。
念及他身具天灵根却明珠蒙尘，又是自己引入宗门的，算是有些香火情，帮一帮倒也无妨。
“宗门之内，自有法度。他若真无故伤你，自有刑堂过问。”白芷语气依旧清冷，但稍缓了些，“不过，废丹院地处偏僻，你谨慎些也是应当。此事我知晓了，我会知会外门刑堂一声……至于这丹药，你自行留着吧，于我无大用。”
北寒风心中一定，脸上露出感激神色，深深一揖：“多谢仙子！仙子恩德，老朽没齿难忘！”
“去吧。”白芷挥了挥手，不再多言，转身走向自己洞府。
北寒风连连作揖，直到白芷身影消失在洞府光幕之后，才缓缓直起身。
脸上那卑微感激的神色如潮水般褪去，恢复成一贯的沉静。
他将木盒收回怀中，转身沿着来路，快速返回了废丹院。
……
接下来的两日，北寒风除了等待红皮葫芦内转化的凝血丹，每日还是依旧清扫着院落。
第三日临近午时，院外传来了熟悉的脚步声，是陈远。
与往日不同，陈远这次脸上少了那份程式化的恭敬，多了几分真切的笑意。
他推开篱笆门，人还未走近，声音就传来：“北师兄，告诉你个好消息。”
北寒风放下手中的扫把，缓缓直起腰，脸上适时地露出些许疑惑和期待：“陈师弟，何事如此欣喜？”
陈远快步走到近前，声音压低：“是关于那位王同源王师兄的！”
“哦？”北寒风浑浊的眼中光芒微闪，“王师兄他……”
“他被外门刑堂下令，面壁思过三个月！”陈远语气带着几分快意，“听说是有弟子向外门刑堂举报，说他平日里横行霸道，欺压同门，刑堂下令让他闭关思过，没有允许，三个月内不得踏出洞府半步！”

The next day, Bei Hanfeng stuffed the wooden box containing the 'Rejuvenation Pill' into his arms, took a deep breath, and walked towards the direction of Bai Zhi Cave.
The inner disciple area was heavily guarded, but fortunately he also had the title of inner disciple. After some interrogations, he still entered the inner disciple area.
But when he arrived at Bai Zhi Cave Mansion after being guided, he found that Bai Zhi was not there.
He could only wait patiently outside the cave door for most of the day.
Finally, a familiar white sword light fell from the sky and landed nearby.
It was Bai Zhi who returned to the cave.
"White Fairy!"
Bei Hanfeng quickly stepped forward and saluted respectfully.
When Bai Zhi saw Bei Hanfeng, a trace of surprise flashed in her cold eyes: "Bei Hanfeng?... You are not in the Waste Pill Academy, what are you doing here?"
Bei Hanfeng had a frightened and sincere look on his face and said, "Fairy Bai, I have something to ask of you, and it concerns my life and safety."
Bai Zhi frowned slightly and looked him over. Seeing that his expression didn't seem to be fake, she pondered for a moment and said, "Come with me."
She did not bring Bei Hanfeng into the cave, but to a secluded pavilion nearby.
"Tell me, what's the matter?"
Bei Hanfeng no longer hesitated, carefully took out the wooden box containing the rejuvenation pills, opened it gently, and handed it to Bai Zhi with both hands.
"This high-grade rejuvenation pill was exchanged by the old man for the low-grade Qi training pill he saved. Thanks to the fairy's care, he was able to enter the fairy gate, so I want to use these two rejuvenation pills as a gift to thank the fairy!"
Bai Zhi glanced at the two radiant elixirs in the wooden box. They were indeed middle-grade rejuvenation elixirs. However, she did not take it, and just said calmly: "If you have any questions, just say so. It doesn't have to be like this."
Beihanfeng took back the wooden box, with deeper wrinkles on his face, and a bit of bitterness in his voice: "I dare not deceive the fairy. A few days ago, a senior fellow from the outer sect named Wang Yuanyuan came to the Abandoned Alchemy Academy, forcibly seized the red sun grass residue, and... humiliated the old man. The old man is old and frail, and his cultivation is low, so he cannot bear to be disturbed. Therefore, I took the liberty to come here and ask the fairy... Can you help me, or give you some protection?"
Bai Zhi frowned slightly when she heard this.
She had heard a little bit about Wang Tongyuan from the outer sect. Because he was a relative of a deacon in the outer sect, he was usually arrogant and domineering in the outer sect. The outer sect disciples and servant disciples were often bullied by him.
She looked towards the north cold wind. The old man's breath was weak and he looked trembling even standing here. He was really pitiful.
Thinking of the fact that he has heavenly spiritual roots but his pearls are covered in dust, and he was introduced into the sect by himself, he has some incestuous feelings, so it doesn't hurt to help him.
"There are laws within the sect. If he really hurts you for no reason, there will be a punishment hall to investigate." Bai Zhi's tone was still cold, but a little calmer, "However, the Waste Pill Courtyard is in a remote location, so you should be more cautious. I know about this, and I will inform the outer punishment hall... As for this pill, you can keep it by yourself, it is of no use to me."
Bei Hanfeng was certain in his heart, with a look of gratitude on his face, and bowed deeply: "Thank you so much, Fairy! Fairy's kindness will be unforgettable to me!"
"Go." Bai Zhi waved her hand, said no more, turned and walked towards her cave.
Beihanfeng bowed repeatedly, until Bai Zhi's figure disappeared behind the light curtain of the cave, and then she slowly straightened up.
The humble and grateful look on his face faded away like a tide, returning to his usual calmness.
He put the wooden box back into his arms, turned around and followed the path he came from, quickly returning to the Wasted Dan Academy.
…
In the next two days, Bei Hanfeng, in addition to waiting for the blood-coagulating pill to be transformed into the red-skinned gourd, continued to clean the courtyard every day.
Near noon on the third day, familiar footsteps were heard outside the hospital. It was Chen Yuan.
Different from the past, Chen Yuan's face this time lacked the stylized respect and had a more genuine smile.
He pushed open the fence door, but before anyone could get closer, a voice came: "Senior Brother Bei, I have good news for you."
Bei Hanfeng put down the broom in his hand and slowly straightened up, his face showing some doubts and expectations at the right time: "Junior brother Chen, why are you so happy?"? "
Chen Yuan quickly walked closer and lowered his voice: "It's about Senior Brother Wang Yuanyuan! "
"oh? "The light in Bei Hanfeng's turbid eyes flashed slightly, "Senior Brother Wang..."
"He was ordered by the Outer Gate Torment Hall to sit in front of the wall and think about it for three months! "Chen Yuan said with a hint of joy in his tone, "I heard that a disciple reported to the Outer Sect's Punishment Hall that he was domineering and bullying his fellow disciples. The Punishment Hall ordered him to retreat and reflect on his mistakes. Without permission, he was not allowed to step out of the cave for three months! "
